faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Research Associate 1 and JRF (GATE) positions at IIT Guwahati is 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate 1 and JRF (GATE) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies, with 1 post for Research Associate 1 and 1 post for JRF (GATE).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF (GATE) position?
faq.answer: The JRF (GATE) position requires a Post-graduate degree in Engineering selected through GATE.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Associate 1 post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Research Associate 1 post is Rs. 68440 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be through an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for IIT Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the specific qualification for Research Associate 1?
faq.answer: Research Associate 1 requires a PhD in Engineering, preferably in Energy/Environment/Chemical Engineering/Biotechnology/Biosciences and Bioengineering, with at least 2 First-author publications on microalgae CO2 capture/Microalgae-based Biofuels/Microalgae Biorefinery.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the Important Links section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" link.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the project for which these positions are available?
faq.answer: The duration for both Research Associate 1 and JRF (GATE) positions is 11 months.
